# Chapter Eight: In The House

Vic had dinner with Jessica and the kids and then washed dishes while she got the kids there bath and then off to bed, he would go up and give them a kiss goodnight once they were snuggled in and stories read. It was her turn and thank god his mind was a mess after today, apparently he was on call but getting paid, which meant he had to be by the phone should the priests need him for anything until he was officially released off of the detail.

He washed the dishes and stacked them in the straining rack, he sighed as he noticed the dishwasher that still needed fixing.

He finished up and went upstairs, he could hear the footsteps finishing up as the boy got into bed and Jessica put the baby down in their room. He walked into toby’s room and saw him getting settled, he had put batman into the bed with him along with the bat mobile, it made for a crowded bed, but he didn’t seem to mind. Until he rolled over onto the car in the middle of the night and woke up, then he would come seek solace in their bed.

Vic stopped in and kissed Toby on the head as he was starting to fall asleep. He headed into the master bedroom at the end of the hall.

Jessica was getting ready for bed, he could see his daughter Carley still squirming as she tried to get out of the swaddle, that kid was going to be a handful, Vic shook his head and began to get ready for bed himself.

They talked about their day, Vic leaving a lot of details out as Jessica didn’t need to know the grizzly parts. And she talking about the kids and asking if he would be home the entire week. They settled in and watched TV for a while until they fell asleep a little before 10 PM.

A crash came from downstairs at around 3 AM. Vic was out of bed before the final tinkle of glass had skittered across the floor. It was the first floor window, sounded like the living room. Jessica was awake a moment later and to her credit, she didn’t scream. “Honey, grab the baby and get ready, when I cover the top of the stairs get Toby and go into the bathroom, into the shower, do you understand me” she nodded and began to move. Vic went to the closet and opened the gun safe, he reached for the.38 and then thought better of it, instead he grabbed the 870 Remington shotgun and a box of shells, as a backup he grabbed the.50 caliber desert eagle his brother had gotten him for Christmas 2 years before, His wife never knew and he never intended to tell her. He grabbed the loaded clip and shoved his pockets with.50 caliber rounds and shotgun shells.

He hesitated for only a second before grabbing the small 5 shot.38 as well. Loading the Shotgun, he watched the top of the stairs from the closet door, from here he had a decent vantage point. If they were going to come upstairs, then they had to use the stair entrance to do it. He cocked the shotgun and ensured the Desert Eagle was loaded. He put on his duty belt and clipped the holster for the eagle on it. at the small of his back, Now he could hear sounds from the first floor, like claws scratching across the wood of the living room. They were moving slowly, but moving none the less.

Jessica had the baby and Vic went to the top of the stairs, as he leveled the shotgun at the turn in the middle of the staircase he nodded towards toby’s room and Jessica lightly ran to the boy’s bedroom, within a moment she came out and moved towards the bathroom, the claw sounds were getting closer, they were still cautious but they were clearer now. It was like they were clearing the first floor. He expected to hear a TV or lamp or something else hit the floor, it was possible they were grabbing some of the electronics downstairs. As Jessica passed him he held out the.38 and whispered in her ear “Lock the door, if anyone, and I mean anyone comes in without knocking, empty this into them, do you understand, point and pull the trigger until it clicks.” She nodded with wide eyes. “He could also see she had grabbed her cell phone, which was good because he had forgotten his, shit he thought at least one of us was thinking ahead. She rushed to the bathroom and closed the door, she would be calling the police right now.

And then Victor’s blood ran cold from the bend in the stairs something spoke, it was guttural and not quite human “Victor, oh Victor is your family safe now, are they quite nestled in, I can smell the fear on your wife. I bet your little girl will taste ooooo sooooo goooooood when I rip her insides out” The voice almost cooed and then a guttural laugh followed, but the tone was different, there was more than one down there. Victor could feel the trembling wanting to enter his limbs, he could feel his bowels want to let go, he was scared, in fact he had never felt this level of fear. But they had said those things about his baby girl, His resolve was steel, he would die before they got to his family.

Vic took a deep breath and waited, he steadied his breathing not letting the adrenaline take too much of a toll on his body, he could already feel his heart wanting to leap out of his chest. And then things went from bad to worse, from around the corner came something that could only have walked out of a nightmare. Standing close to 8 feet tall was a creature covered in black fur and a large muzzle from tip to the curve at the back where the muzzle separated into top and bottom were filled with Razor sharp yellow teeth. And then Victor looked at its eyes, its blazing white eyes and before he knew it, mostly out of reflex he pulled the trigger and the snout disintegrated into blood and bone. The creature roared and was slammed back against the wall.

Before he could think he had pumped the shotgun and put another shell into the creature, this time its upper chest was peppered with shot causing more blood and skin to flay open exposing bone and muscle. From the other side another creature this one seemingly a little thinner and shorter was trying to crawl over it to get to Victor, He put the third shot into the side of its head. And watched with fascination as the hair, skin and tissue peeled back to expose skull and blood. How were these things not dead he thought and kept pulling the trigger, slamming both creatures against the wall with the foot pounds of pressure put out by the shotgun. He snarled as he pulled the trigger again and again sending white hot agony at the creatures who could not exist. He could feel his mind looking for an answer and finding none, and then came a dry click from the shotgun as the pin came down on an empty chamber. The smaller creature moved slowly but moved none the less, a sound coming from its fractured maw that sounded like laughter, half of its left side was exposed as blood leaked down its dark coat and spread across the floor. The larger one began to move as well its face seeming to to heal back into a shape that resembled its original form. Victor stood there for a moment In utter horrid fascination as the creatures began to heal before his eyes and as they did, there motions became a little faster, they were now at the bottom of the stairs and the smaller ones clawed foot touched the bottom step.

Victor seeing only 10 steps between him and death, suddenly snapped out of his nightmare long enough to reach around and produce the desert eagle. He pointed it at the things head and pulled the trigger. The bullet slammed into the creature’s forehead splitting it open like a melon, the force slammed it back into the other creature sending them reeling for the wall at the stair turn. Victor Roared with fear and rage and panic and just pulled the trigger unloading.50 caliber rounds into he heads and chest of both monsters. He could see large holes that led through the creatures and out into the yard and yet they still moved. The larger creature, mostly protected behind the smaller one grabbed it and pulled it out of sight of Victor he could hear it huffing and mewling as it moved down the stairs.

Victor reloaded the desert eagle and began to reload the shotgun as well, the claw sounds were slow and one set sounded like it was being dragged. They were moving away but Victor couldn’t bring himself to move from his position, he was completely terrified and did not want to see anymore tonight, but they would not get his family, the bathroom had no windows and only one door. If they were going to get them, they would have to go through Victor and he had given them one good accounting. Just as he finished loading the shotgun the window and door of his sons room exploded and something large, hairy and feral bounded the few steps to Victor, it picked him up off his feet slapping away the shotgun and drove him against the wall next to the bathroom.

He couldn’t breathe, it was like getting hit by a car, he didn’t hurt but he thought that was from the adrenaline, he would feel it later. Its face was mere inches from his as he stared down the fanged muzzle into Yellow piercing eyes. “You will pay for this human” it said in that same gravelly voice, dammit he hadn’t known there was a third, and that they could move so fast. He knew he was dead, there was no stopping that this thing would rip him into shreds in a second. But two things happened at once that probably saved his life. The baby began crying and Sirens were heard coming up the street, The creature turned its head towards the downstairs listening to the sirens and the cry of the baby broke down Vic’s fear, he reached around his back and pulled the Desert Eagle once again, He planted the gun against the side of the things head “Why don’t you just fucking DIE” he said and pulled the trigger twice, watching the other side of its skull spray over the door to the bathroom, hoping the bullet didn’t hit the kids or his wife.

The thing howled in pain and dropped Victor, From the floor he had no fear of hitting his family and pumped 4 rounds into the chest of the creature standing above him, It drove it back down the hall. The creature snarled and gibbered as it held its head but it swung around and back into his son’s room, he heard the rest of the glass as it launched itself out the window.

Victor slumped to the floor holding the smoking Gun and then he then peed himself. Not 30 seconds later two officers came rushing in guns up and trained, they entered the second floor yelling for Victor to drop the weapon, he couldn’t hear them, he couldn’t hear anything the gun shots had temporarily deafened him, or the fear he wasn’t sure. He just sat there staring off into the hall. A moment later someone took the gun from his hand and then Jessica was standing in front of him and between him and the officers hands out telling them what had happened. Victor did not interject, in fact he did not say anything, how could he, he had just shot at movie monsters, something out of a bad horror flick. Who would believe him so he just sat there staring blankly down the hall.

30 minutes later, an unarmed but still wearing pee stained bed pants, sat in his dining room with a blanket over his shoulders, Paramedics were checking him out and fussing over his wounds, they had set his arm and were arguing with the police about transporting him to the hospital when the two Priests walked in with their two DOJ accomplices right behind them. Badges were shown, protests were made but within 15 minutes the officers and paramedics were ushered out of the house by the Department of Justice suits while the Bishop took Jessica into the kitchen, his arm around her comforting her and the children she held to her, once she had explained the situation to the officers and handed them both the guns, the one she had and the one she had just taken off her husband, she had gone back into the bathroom, despite the protests of the officers to stay still and came back clinging her children, she had not put them down since.

Sam sat down in front of Vic and looked up into his eyes “Hell of a night huh Vic” he said to his friend, Vic could see the pain in his friend’s eyes but did not understand yet why. Vic didn’t say anything just nodded his head at his friend. “Your damn lucky, they didn’t consider you a threat and decided to play around, had they actually thought to attack you, you wouldn’t be sitting here my friend” Sam was looking directly into Vic’s eyes, when they changed, the look from dazed confusion to comprehension. Sam wasn’t talking about burglars; he was talking about those things. Vic leaned forward a fierce fire in his eyes “What the fuck were they Sam, what do you know” he said not letting his gaze leave his friend.

Sam stared back, “I know a lot my friend but we can’t talk here, we need to get Jessica and the kids to safety and then you and I need to have a long conversation, though you might want to change first” Sam said standing and nodding to the Department of Justice guys, who began to usher in the paramedics to transport Vic.
